packages.name: PCB Trace Length Analyzer
packages.description: Length matching for DDR, Ethernet, USB, PCIe, MIPI and SD on the open board. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.
packages.description_full:
Measures every interface on the board open in the PCB Editor -- DDR (per leg of the fly-by chain), Ethernet, USB, PCIe, MIPI, SD and any differential pair -- against its length target, and says for each net whether it is too short or too long and by how much.

Click a net in the report to select it in KiCad, select every out-of-tolerance net at once, or select a track in KiCad and see how far its net is from target. The analysis runs on your machine: nothing is uploaded and the plugin opens no network connections.

Requires KiCad 10.0.1 or newer with the API server enabled (Preferences > Plugins > Enable KiCad API). The first run installs PySide6 with QtWebEngine into the plugin's Python environment, a download of several hundred MB.
